query: Why was my Student's Pass application rejected?
reference_answer: We regret to inform you that we are unable to share specific information on the assessment of applications. All Student's Pass application are carefully considered and reviewed by ICA.You may refer to Becoming a Student's Pass Holder for more information on Student's Pass requirements.
context:
[Document 1]
We regret to inform you that we are unable to share specific information on the assessment of applications. All Student's Pass application are carefully considered and reviewed by ICA.You may refer to Becoming a Student's Pass Holder for more information on Student's Pass requirements.

[Document 2]
You must be accepted for admission into a full-time course by a recognised education institution in Singapore to apply for renewal of your Student's Pass. You may renew your Student's Pass online using the e-Service.

[Document 3]
Upon issuance of a Student's pass, your Dependant's Pass will be automatically cancelled.

[Document 4]
If you hold a valid Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP), Dependant's Pass (DP) or Immigration Exemption Order (IEO), you are not required to obtain a Student's Pass to pursue full-time, non-religious related studies in Singapore. You may enrol in any full-time, non-religious course within the duration of your existing pass.If you hold a valid LTVP or DP and wish to study in an approved religious school/madrasah, you will still need to obtain a Student’s Pass. Holders of a valid IEO are exempted from this requirement.

[Document 5]
Upon course completion, students will have to cancel their Student's Pass (STP) and surrender any physical STP card that was issued to them for cancellation to ICA. Upon cancellation of their STP, they may be granted a short-term visit pass to stay in Singapore (up to 89 days).If you are studying in an Institute of Higher Learning (IHL) and wish to have a longer period of stay to look for jobs upon completion of your course, you may apply for a one-year (non-renewable) long term visit pass (LTVP).You may refer to LTVP for Graduate from IHL Seeking Employment in Singapore for more details.
answer: Your application might have been rejected because you didn't meet the requirement of being accepted for admission into a full-time course by a recognized Singaporean institution. Additionally, ensure you're following all Student's Pass requirements as outlined in the guidelines. [Document 1]
